verses.html: 1 Now the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread were two days away, and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a covert way to arrest Jesus and kill Him.
verses.text: 1 Now the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread were two days away, and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a covert way to arrest Jesus and kill Him.

verses.html: 2 “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
verses.text: 2 “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”

verses.html: 3 While Jesus was in Bethany reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke open the jar and poured it on Jesus’ head.
verses.text: 3 While Jesus was in Bethany reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke open the jar and poured it on Jesus’ head.

verses.html: 4 Some of those present, however, expressed their indignation to one another: “Why this waste of perfume?
verses.text: 4 Some of those present, however, expressed their indignation to one another: “Why this waste of perfume?

verses.html: 5 It could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor.” And they scolded her.
verses.text: 5 It could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor.” And they scolded her.

verses.html: 6 But Jesus said, “Leave her alone; why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
verses.text: 6 But Jesus said, “Leave her alone; why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.

verses.html: 7 The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them whenever you want. But you will not always have Me.
verses.text: 7 The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them whenever you want. But you will not always have Me.

verses.html: 8 She has done what she could to anoint My body in advance of My burial.
verses.text: 8 She has done what she could to anoint My body in advance of My burial.

verses.html: 9 And truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”
verses.text: 9 And truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”

verses.html: 10 Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
verses.text: 10 Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.

verses.html: 11 They were delighted to hear this, and they promised to give him money. So Judas began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus.
verses.text: 11 They were delighted to hear this, and they promised to give him money. So Judas began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus.

verses.html: 1 Now the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread was in two days, and the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how, having seized him by deceit, they might kill him.
verses.text: 1 Now the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread was in two days, and the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how, having seized him by deceit, they might kill him.

verses.html: 2 For they were saying, “Not during the festival, so that there will not be a riot of the people.”
verses.text: 2 For they were saying, “Not during the festival, so that there will not be a riot of the people.”

verses.html: 3 And he being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, he reclining to eat, a woman came, having an alabaster jar of very precious perfumed oil of pure nard. Having broken the jar, she poured it on his head.
verses.text: 3 And he being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, he reclining to eat, a woman came, having an alabaster jar of very precious perfumed oil of pure nard. Having broken the jar, she poured it on his head.

verses.html: 4 But there were some being very angry within themselves, “For what has this waste of the perfumed oil happened?
verses.text: 4 But there were some being very angry within themselves, “For what has this waste of the perfumed oil happened?

verses.html: 5 For this perfumed oil was able to be sold for more than 300 denarii and given to the poor.” And they were scolding her.
verses.text: 5 For this perfumed oil was able to be sold for more than 300 denarii and given to the poor.” And they were scolding her.

verses.html: 6 But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why are you causing trouble for her? She did a good work in me.
verses.text: 6 But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why are you causing trouble for her? She did a good work in me.

verses.html: 7 For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you desire, you are able to do good to them, but you do not always have me.
verses.text: 7 For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you desire, you are able to do good to them, but you do not always have me.

verses.html: 8 What she had, she did. She anticipated to anoint my body for burial.
verses.text: 8 What she had, she did. She anticipated to anoint my body for burial.

verses.html: 9 And truly I say to you, wherever the gospel is preached in the whole world, also what she did will be spoken in remembrance of her.”
verses.text: 9 And truly I say to you, wherever the gospel is preached in the whole world, also what she did will be spoken in remembrance of her.”

verses.html: 10 And Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went away to the chief priests so that he might hand him over to them.
verses.text: 10 And Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went away to the chief priests so that he might hand him over to them.

verses.html: 11 And they, having heard {it}, rejoiced and promised to give him silver. And he was seeking how he might opportunely hand him over.
verses.text: 11 And they, having heard {it}, rejoiced and promised to give him silver. And he was seeking how he might opportunely hand him over.

verses.html: 1 At that time, it was only two days until the Passover festival, which was the first day of the Celebration of Unleavened Bread. The ruling priests and the teachers of the Jewish law were planning a clever way to arrest Jesus and have people execute him.
verses.text: 1 At that time, it was only two days until the Passover festival, which was the first day of the Celebration of Unleavened Bread. The ruling priests and the teachers of the Jewish law were planning a clever way to arrest Jesus and have people execute him.

verses.html: 2 {They were planning something clever} because they agreed that they would not act during the festival period. Otherwise, the people who were there in Jerusalem might riot.
verses.text: 2 {They were planning something clever} because they agreed that they would not act during the festival period. Otherwise, the people who were there in Jerusalem might riot.

verses.html: 3 Now Jesus was in the village of Bethany. He was in the home of Simon, who used to have a skin disease. While Jesus was feasting {there}, a woman arrived. She brought with her a stone jar that contained nard, a very valuable, fragrant ointment. She shattered the jar and poured the ointment on Jesus’ head.
verses.text: 3 Now Jesus was in the village of Bethany. He was in the home of Simon, who used to have a skin disease. While Jesus was feasting {there}, a woman arrived. She brought with her a stone jar that contained nard, a very valuable, fragrant ointment. She shattered the jar and poured the ointment on Jesus’ head.

verses.html: 4 Some of the people there were very upset. {They said} to each other, “She wasted the fragrant ointment!
verses.text: 4 Some of the people there were very upset. {They said} to each other, “She wasted the fragrant ointment!

verses.html: 5 She could have sold this fragrant ointment for at least 300 coins! Then, she could have given {that money} to poor people.” So, they rebuked her.
verses.text: 5 She could have sold this fragrant ointment for at least 300 coins! Then, she could have given {that money} to poor people.” So, they rebuked her.

verses.html: 6 However, Jesus told {those people}, “Stop rebuking this woman. Do not bother her! What she did for me was right.
verses.text: 6 However, Jesus told {those people}, “Stop rebuking this woman. Do not bother her! What she did for me was right.

verses.html: 7 There will always be poor people with you, so you can help them whenever you want to. However, I will not always be with you.
verses.text: 7 There will always be poor people with you, so you can help them whenever you want to. However, I will not always be with you.

verses.html: 8 This woman used what she possessed to do {something for me}. When she poured this ointment on me, she was preparing me ahead of time for when someone buries me.
verses.text: 8 This woman used what she possessed to do {something for me}. When she poured this ointment on me, she was preparing me ahead of time for when someone buries me.

verses.html: 9 In every place where my apprentices proclaim the good news, they will also tell what this woman just did. That way, people will remember her. What I have said is true.”
verses.text: 9 In every place where my apprentices proclaim the good news, they will also tell what this woman just did. That way, people will remember her. What I have said is true.”

verses.html: 10 Then Judas Iscariot visited the ruling priests to talk about helping them arrest Jesus. He was one of the 12 men whom Jesus had chosen to represent him.
verses.text: 10 Then Judas Iscariot visited the ruling priests to talk about helping them arrest Jesus. He was one of the 12 men whom Jesus had chosen to represent him.

verses.html: 11 When the ruling priests heard from Judas, they were very happy. They agreed to pay money to Judas {to help them arrest Jesus}. So, Judas tried to find a good time to help {the ruling priests} arrest Jesus.
verses.text: 11 When the ruling priests heard from Judas, they were very happy. They agreed to pay money to Judas {to help them arrest Jesus}. So, Judas tried to find a good time to help {the ruling priests} arrest Jesus.

verses.text: 8 She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

verses.html: 9 Mostcertainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”
